evidence.ACL: The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
evidence.MCL: Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, with extending into the surface, in favor of tear.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: No strong MR evidence of tear of lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: Osteoarthritis of left knee joint with spur formation and subchondral bone marrow edema/cysts of patella and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage, more severe at medial facet of patella and medial femoral condyle.
evidence.Lateral OA: Osteoarthritis of left knee joint with spur formation and subchondral bone marrow edema/cysts of patella and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage
evidence.PF OA: subchondral bone marrow edema/cysts of patella and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage, more severe at medial facet of patella
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
